rules: Criteria and both guide strings fixed before first embedding. No output repair, no retry, no revised expected values.
Continue across structurally valid batches within one total operation budget and explicit call limit only.
Any unknown usage or global limit stops subsequent cases. Independent known failures retained.
All paired cases use identical files, query, model, output cap, fixed batches and budget; only guide changes.
Long table and full DOCX are new-guide workflow checks only, not paired quality evidence.
Relation expectations are diagnostic expectations, never sent to the model. Not independent human review or Stage12 acceptance.
